description.subtitle: Adidas water bottle from the Manchester United 600 ml - red
description.tagline: Hydration with the spirit of Manchester United
description.intro: The 600 ml adidas Manchester United bottle is the perfect accessory to accompany you in workouts, matches or your daily routine. Its red design with the club's official shield reflects all the passion and character of the Red Devils.
key_benefits: Capacidad de 600 ml: Ideal para entrenamientos y uso diario.
Material resistente: Fabricado en metal duradero.
Safe closure cap: Avoid spills and facilitate use.
Official design Manchester United: With club shield and adidas logo.
Easy transport: Includes handle for convenience.
